text: I appreciate that. I know you're only doing your job.
style: Operations manager and OT engineer at a grid battery site, mid-fifties. Speak with a consistent North-East English (Teesside) accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Firm, low-to-mid pitch; brisk, clipped pace. Conscientious and overworked; defensive at first, then alarmed and determined once he realises the threat is real.
